  "domain_file": "(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types block counter)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x - block ?y - block)
    (on-table ?x - block)
    (clear ?x - block)
    (holding ?x - block)
    (arm-empty)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: stack-count abstraction for at-most-3-stacks
    (stacks ?n - counter)
    (inc-to ?from - counter ?to - counter)
    (dec-to ?from - counter ?to - counter)
    (le3 ?n - counter)
  )

  ;; Pick up a clear block from the table. This reduces the number of table stacks by one.
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b - block ?n - counter ?m - counter)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                       (stacks ?n) (dec-to ?n ?m) (le3 ?n))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (not (stacks ?n))
                 (stacks ?m))
  )

  ;; Put down a held block on the table. This creates a new table stack, so the count increases by one.
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b - block ?n - counter ?m - counter)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b)
                       (stacks ?n) (inc-to ?n ?m)
                       (le3 ?n) (le3 ?m))
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (stacks ?n))
                 (stacks ?m))
  )

  ;; Stack a held block onto a clear block. Stack count is unchanged.
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b - block ?c - block ?n - counter)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c)
                       (stacks ?n) (le3 ?n))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)))
  )

  ;; Unstack a clear block from another block. Stack count is unchanged.
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b - block ?c - block ?n - counter)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                       (stacks ?n) (le3 ?n))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
)

  (:predicates

    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ; CONSTRAINT: marks blocks that have been put down on the table and cannot be picked up again
    (never-pickup ?x)
  )

    :parameters (?b)
    ; CONSTRAINT: a block already put down on the table cannot be picked up
    :precondition (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty) (not (never-pickup ?b)))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    ; CONSTRAINT: putting a block on the table makes it permanently non-pickup-able
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (never-pickup ?b))
